title: The Atticus Institute
description:
S1
In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

title: Beneath
description:
S1
Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

title: The Birds II: Land's End
description:
S1
Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

title: The Black Castle
description:
S1
An Englishman (Richard Greene) enters an Austrian nobleman's (Stephen McNally) castle, complete with torture chamber and alligator moat.

title: Blood Creek
description:
S1
Two brothers become entangled in a sinister Nazi's occult experiment at an American farmhouse.

title: Captive Wild Woman
description:
S1
A mad doctor (John Carradine) turns an animal trainer's (Milburn Stone) ape into Paula the ape-woman (Acquanetta).

title: Cherry Falls
description:
S1
A serial killer stalking virgins in a small Virginia town targets an idealistic teenager (Brittany Murphy).

title: Cry Wolf
description:
S1
Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
description:
S1
A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

title: The Darkness
description:
S1
A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.

title: Delirium
description:
S1
A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.
